---
title: "Eskom tariff increases versus inflation"
---

Annual Eskom tariff increases compared with consumer price inflation. This is a small
practice project; see the repository for the data sources and code.

```{python}
#| include: false
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go

tables = Path("..") / "outputs" / "tables"
table = pd.read_csv(tables / "comparison.csv")
summary = pd.read_csv(tables / "summary.csv").iloc[0]
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
from IPython.display import Markdown
Markdown(
    f"Over **{int(summary['years'])} years**, the tariff rose by "
    f"**{summary['tariff_total_growth_pct']:,.0f}%** (about "
    f"{summary['tariff_cagr_pct']:.1f}% a year) while CPI rose by "
    f"**{summary['cpi_total_growth_pct']:,.0f}%** (about "
    f"{summary['cpi_cagr_pct']:.1f}% a year). The tariff increase was above inflation in "
    f"{int(summary['years_tariff_above_cpi'])} of {int(summary['years'])} years."
)
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
fig = go.Figure()
fig.add_bar(x=table["fy_label"], y=table["increase_pct"], name="Eskom tariff increase")
fig.add_bar(x=table["fy_label"], y=table["cpi_avg_pct"], name="CPI inflation")
fig.update_layout(barmode="group", title="Annual increases (%)", yaxis_title="% per year")
fig
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
fig = go.Figure()
fig.add_scatter(x=table["fy_label"], y=table["tariff_index"], name="Eskom tariff")
fig.add_scatter(x=table["fy_label"], y=table["cpi_index"], name="CPI")
fig.update_layout(title="Cumulative increase (100 = start of period)", yaxis_title="Index")
fig
```

*Scenario note: tariffs are Eskom's approved annual increases; CPI is the annual average.
Sources and verification status are listed in data/raw/SOURCES.md.*
